text:
Aisha (oncall): :rotating_light: paging: spike of 502s across prod-east for model-serving tier. rate ~40% errors on /v1/generate. Happening since 11:03 UTC. Investigating logs now.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] prod-east: increase in 502 errors (svc: inference-gateway) — severity: P1. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall Aisha. Link: https://ops.redwood/logs/alert/1769554321
Ravi (sre): grabbing metrics. Can you confirm if this is a single model or whole cluster?
Aisha (oncall): graphs show 502s from gateway -> runtime, 2 nodes repeatedly flapping with high GPU mem usage. Both nodes are on the same AZ. Not sure if model-specific yet.
Kelsey (eng): adding context: we pushed a runtime tweak two days ago that changed kv-cache eviction timing. Could be related.
Jordan (prod): start customer-impact triage: which customers hit? any paid SLAs affected?
Aisha (oncall): customer list from logs: three high-volume tenants (acme-inc, beta-chat, q3-saas). acme-inc saw 15% failed requests in last 20m.
Marta (pm): tagging: acme-inc account team FYI @Jordan — they have enterprise SLA. Need comms if >30m.
Ravi (sre): mitigation idea: temporarily route traffic away from AZ with flapping nodes and scale up healthy nodes. Also consider fallback to older runtime image.
Kelsey (eng): I can push a hotfix revert to runtime image v1.43 -> v1.42. That needs a canary push to avoid blast radius.
Aisha (oncall): agreed. Quick steps: 1) enable routing to other AZs 2) canary revert on one node 3) monitor error rate. Who can do the canary?
Kelsey (eng): I will do canary revert now. DeployBot: starting canary rollback to runtime:v1.42 on node inference-03.
DeployBot: canary started. logs: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/inference-runtime -n prod --selector=node=inference-03`
Ravi (sre): scaling up healthy pool by +2 replicas in prod-east to absorb traffic. `kubectl scale` applied.
Aisha (oncall): rerouting 40% traffic to prod-west for next 15m.
IncidentBot: [UPDATE] error rate dropping to 12% after canary. Continue monitoring.
Kelsey (eng): canary looks stable for 8m. Initiating gradual rollback on remaining nodes.
Aisha (oncall): error rate now 2.5% — within SLO. Rolling back mitigation plan to normal traffic.
Jordan (prod): great. Customer impact summary for post-incident: acme-inc 15% failure window 11:03–11:25 (~22m), beta-chat intermittent errors 5–8% same window, q3-saas single minute spike. No data loss. We'll prepare comms.
Marta (pm): schedule postmortem sync: propose 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC (1h). Attendees: eng runtime, SRE, product, account team.
Kelsey (eng): +1. I'll prepare deploy logs and the canary diff.
Ravi (sre): I'll produce timeline and alerting gaps. Noted that runbook step for AZ isolation is fuzzy.
Aisha (oncall): action items from live:
- AI-1: Add an automated policy to shift 50% traffic off AZ if node flapping > 10% for 5m. Owner: Ravi. Est: S (1 day). Priority: P0 (must fix this quarter).
- AI-2: Add a pre-deploy canary check for recent kv-cache changes; extend canary window to 15m by default. Owner: Kelsey. Est: M (3 days). Priority: P1.
- AI-3: Improve customer-impact query to map errors -> tenant quickly (dashboard widget). Owner: Jordan. Est: M (2 days). Priority: P1.
- AI-4: Update runbook: explicit AZ-isolation mitigation steps + playbook. Owner: Aisha. Est: S (0.5 day). Priority: P0.
- AI-5: Postmortem doc & comm draft for acme-inc and internal notes. Owner: Marta. Est: S (0.5 day). Priority: P0 (SLA comms).
Jordan (prod): mapping to Q2/Q3 planning: AI-1 and AI-4 are Q2 infra priorities (reliability OKR). AI-2 bumps to Q3 if larger refactor needed but we should try to land minimal changes this sprint.
Marta (pm): tagging quarterly tie-in: reliability OKR = reduce cross-AZ incidents impact by 50%. Recommend AI-1 be high priority.
Kelsey (eng): note on sizing: AI-2 might be M->L if we add e2e test infra for kv-cache behavior. For now estimate M but mark as blockable.
Ravi (sre): I'll open the incident ticket and add labels: severity:P1, impacted-customers:[acme-inc], qtr:Q2, owners:[Ravi,Kelsey,Jordan].
Aisha (oncall): postmortem agenda for sync: 1) timeline & detection 2) root-cause hypotheses (runtime revert vs AZ hardware) 3) customer impact & comms 4) action items + owners + sizing 5) acceptance criteria + roll-forward plan.
Marta (pm): please add acceptance criteria for each AI in the postmortem doc, e.g., AI-1 acceptance = automated reroute triggers within 30s of policy.
Kelsey (eng): prepping logs tarball: `curl -o logs.tgz "https://ops.redwood/logs/bundle?alert=1769554321"` and will attach to doc.
Ravi (sre): linking monitoring improvement ticket: https://tracker.redwood/INC-8742 (will copy to postmortem).
IncidentBot: [ACTION-LOGGED] Incident 1769554321 - created postmortem draft: https://pm.redwood/postmortem/1769554321
Aisha (oncall): final note: root cause still TBD. Immediate mitigation (rollback + AZ routing) worked. Prioritize automation so next time it's auto-handled.
Marta (pm): I'll draft customer comm for acme-inc and run by legal. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (prod): owners — ping in 48h for status updates on AI tasks.
Kelsey (eng): thanks all. I'll link the canary diff and rollback plan in the postmortem doc.
Ravi (sre): leaving a follow-up: add synthetic test that exercises kv-cache eviction pattern nightly. Owner: Ravi. Est: M (3 days). Priority: P1.
Aisha (oncall): closing live thread — moving to postmortem channel after we create the doc. Good work team :thumbsup:
